name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Lumen goes with Engineer or Anders goes with Lumen.
Ceres goes with at most one of Fontaine, Navigator, Cortex, and Plankton.
Cortex goes with at least one of Fontaine, Captain, or Regolith.
Navigator goes with exactly three of Eklund, Lumen, Europa, and Plankton.
Between Fontaine and Lumen, one goes with Navigator and the other with Regolith.
If Plankton does not go with Eklund, then Ceres does not go with Eklund.

hints.text: Suppose Fontaine went with Navigator — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

From the clue “Navigator goes with exactly three of Eklund, Lumen, Europa, and Plankton” — Navigator must go with Lumen.
From the clue “Navigator goes with exactly three of Eklund, Lumen, Europa, and Plankton” — Navigator must go with Plankton.
The clues force Fontaine to not go with Regolith.
The clues force Lumen to not go with Regolith.
…but now the clue “Between Fontaine and Lumen, one goes with Navigator and the other with Regolith” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Fontaine does not go with Navigator.
